T:P1.6.text: With over 30 owned and licensed global brands in our portfolio, our strengths across the full product life cycle enable us to unlock their value and fuel growth.

T:P1.7.text: Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Since its inception the brand has created a lasting impact on the fashion industry, becoming synonymous with creativity, individuality, and timeless craftsmanship. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

T:P1.9.text: the House of Karl Lagerfeld shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its namesake, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit.

T:P1.10.text: From the house founded by Donna Karan DKNY emerged.

T:P1.11.text: Vilebrequin cultivates a spirit of refinement and fantasy, staying true to the casual charm the house was founded on in St. Tropez. Vilebrequin joined the G-III portfolio providing the company with a new core competency and a robust global retail network.

T:P1.12.text: G-III’s success comes from our agility, drive and dedication to delivering for our customers. Every member of the team brings a unique point of view that adds something special to our company and the products we create.

T:P2.3.text: G-III excels at bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create. We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, which enables us to fuel the growth of a substantial portfolio of brands. With more than 30 licensed and owned brands, including some of the most sought-after names in global fashion, our success is driven by our team’s entrepreneurial spirit and our deep relationships across the industry.

T:P2.4.text: Bring excitement to fashion by unlocking the potential of our brands

T:P2.5.text: Platform for Success that powers our priorities:

T:P2.6.text: High-performing, forward-thinking team and experienced senior leadership

C:P1.3.text: Distinctive Brands Inspired by the Human Spirit

C:P2.2.text: Deckers’ portfolio of brands combines style, comfort, and performance, each with its unique spirit. Whether navigating the rugged outdoors or strolling urban streets, our brands inspire individuals to embark on their unique journeys and express their true selves.

C:P2.3.text: by an Australian surfer on the coast of California, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot. First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors and then the world, UGG® designs and retails footwear, apparel, accessories and homewares with an uncompromising attitude toward quality and craftsmanship. UGG® partners with the best retailers globally and owns over 130 concept and outlet stores worldwide in key markets including New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Paris, London, Tokyo, Shanghai and ...

C:P2.4.text: HOKA produces premium performance footwear and apparel for athletes of all types. With a bold and unexpected approach, HOKA empowers a world of athletes to fly over the Earth.

C:P2.5.text: Pioneered Teva® stands for freedom in footwear. Teva believes that how you choose to live is the ultimate form of personal expression and our products are crafted to be accessible, versatile and a celebration of the independent spirit.

C:P3.2.text: Equally significant is our responsibility to employ socially conscious operations and sustainable business practices.

C:P3.3.text: As a global leader, Deckers is deeply committed to responsibility in everything we do.

C:P3.4.text: As a global leader in the footwear and apparel sector, our worldwide reach and impact are significant. Deckers is committed to delivering quality products while employing sustainable business practices.

C:P3.5.text: Deckers has established a robust Environmental and Social Governance (ESG) program. Through global community initiatives, mindful product creation, and our thoughtful supply chain efforts, sustainability is not just a goal, it’s what we do.

C:P3.6.text: Read our Creating Change report to learn more.

C:P3.7.text: VIEW REPORT Pathway to Creating Change

C:P3.8.text: As a leader in the footwear, apparel and accessories industry, our worldwide scope and impact is significant. Equally significant is our responsibility to employ socially conscious operations and sustainable business practices.

C:P3.9.text: We embrace each of our unique experiences, knowing that they help us foster connections, drive innovation and create a culture of belonging.

C:P3.10.text: The world has been very good to us. In turn, we want to be good to the world.

C:P3.11.text: At Deckers, we focus on positive change, innovate with purpose, and work to reduce our impact on the environment.

C:P3.12.text: Deckers operates in transparency of purpose and updates our policies regularly, in line with global standards and best practice.
